verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents automatic, context-driven activation: Claude uses skills when relevant and loads the full SKILL.md when it judges a skill relevant (docs-2, docs-3, docs-25). It also provides guidance for engineering descriptions, such as stating what the skill does and when to use it (docs-17, docs-32), plus a skill-creator tool that optimizes descriptions for triggering accuracy (docs-14). Hands-on reports concretely contradict reliable auto-triggering: several users say skills don't fire on expected keywords even with proper YAML and semantic triggers and must be invoked explicitly (comm-12, comm-13), and a cited Vercel eval found the skill was never invoked in 56% of cases (comm-14). Missing for 10: independently verified reliable automatic triggering, and published evidence that description optimization actually improves activation accuracy.
